title: Antonio excellent guide!
text: Our guide Antonio was excellent! We did the tour at a very good pace, explained in great detail the most important of the places visited and the viewpoints. I highly recommend this tour.

title: Must do! Great tour :)
text: This was a great tour! I felt like I got to not only see the city but truly learn about the neighborhoods and the way they’ve adapted over 1000 years. The tour guide is astonishingly knowledge & she had no issue answering the onslaught of questions we threw at her. She was on time & reliable. I would strongly recommend this tour to anyone I knew visiting Granada
author: brittanyrey

title: Wonderful visit with a great guide (Cinthia)
text: On January 18th we made the guided tour of the Albaicín and Sacromonte de Granada with Cinthia. The visit was 10. It was a wonderful visit, as the guide told us the story in a very pleasant way. In addition, the guide was attentive to the group all the time, asking us questions and answering questions. We would definitely choose Cinthia as our guide again because she was great. We loved it!
